def countOilDeposits(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    visited = [[False for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    deposit_count = 0

    for i in range(rows):
        for j in range(cols):
            if grid[i][j] == '@' and not visited[i][j]:
                deposit_count += 1
                dfs(grid, i, j, visited)

    return deposit_count

def dfs(grid, i, j, visited):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    visited[i][j] = True

    if i-1 >= 0 and grid[i-1][j] == '@' and not visited[i-1][j]:
        dfs(grid, i-1, j, visited)
    if j-1 >= 0 and grid[i][j-1] == '@' and not visited[i][j-1]:
        dfs(grid, i, j-1, visited)
    if i+1 < rows and grid[i+1][j] == '@' and not visited[i+1][j]:
        dfs(grid, i+1, j, visited)
    if j+1 < cols and grid[i][j+1] == '@' and not visited[i][j+1]:
        dfs(grid, i, j+1, visited)

def minOperations(n):
    # Initialize the array with the given formula
    arr = [i * 2 + 1 for i in range(n)]
    # Initialize the difference array with the differences between adjacent elements
    diff = [arr[i + 1] - arr[i] for i in range(n - 1)]
    # Initialize the count of operations
    count = 0

    # Iterate until the difference array has only one element
    while len(diff) > 1:
        # Find the index of the maximum difference
        max_index = diff.index(max(diff))
        # Increment the count of operations
        count += 1
        # Update the difference array
        diff = [diff[i] - diff[max_index] for i in range(len(diff)) if i != max_index]

    return count
